statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent palpitations and intermittent episodes of syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is ordered
The service is CPT code 93247 for a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R55
The claim was denied based on Reason Code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
